open_points.subject: A3 rule 3 delivery read
open_points.text: A named file that A1 orders 1 and 2 do not reject from its metadata is read once, and the bytes that were read are the bytes judged, hashed and prepared.
open_points.question: If the path passes metadata orders 1 and 2 but the opened object is not a regular file or opening fails, is any read performed, and which A1 order decides the result?
options: Check the opened object before reading; order 3 or 5 decides and no read occurs.
Attempt one read whenever metadata passed orders 1 and 2; the read result may instead produce order 1, 4 or 5.
Treat “is read once” as meaning one opening/read attempt, not a successful read.
open_points.default_guess: Check the opened object first and read once only if it is still a regular file.

witness.initial: The named path is a regular non-empty file when its path metadata is read.
events: Syncthing replaces the path with a FIFO after the metadata reading and before it is opened.
The deliverer opens the FIFO in non-blocking mode.
outcomes: A1 order 3 is applied before reading and the delivery fails with NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE.
A3 rule 3 is read literally, one read returns no bytes, and the delivery fails with EMPTY under A1 order 1.
witness.observer: The delivery caller sees a different PlacementFailure member.

open_points.subject: A1 opened-file modification time
open_points.text: A file that is read takes its modification time from the file that was opened, the one whose bytes were read, and a delivery uses that time under A2 rule 3.
open_points.question: Exactly when and how many times is the opened file's modification time read, and how is its filesystem precision converted to the UTC-without-offset datetime used by the delivery?
options: Read it once from the opened descriptor immediately after opening, before reading bytes.
Read it once from the opened descriptor after the byte read finishes.
Read it before and after reading and define which value or stability rule applies.
Use the listing metadata value when it still identifies the opened file.
open_points.default_guess: Read it once with descriptor metadata immediately after opening, convert the represented instant to a naive UTC datetime, and truncate excess precision to the datetime representation.

witness.initial: A regular source file has modification time T0 and passes the listing metadata checks.
events: The deliverer opens the file and begins reading it.
Another actor modifies the open file during the read, changing its modification time to T1.
outcomes: Reading descriptor metadata before the byte read gives the prepared photo date T0.
Reading descriptor metadata after the byte read gives the prepared photo date T1.
witness.observer: The Portal and its users see a different photo_date.

open_points.subject: INV-02 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-02: for content with no placement, an empty or absolute name, a name with an empty, `.` or `..` segment, an ignored name at any level, a folder, and a path through a symbolic link each fail with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure and add no file except the project lock (`test_a_name_a_scan_would_not_report_is_not_delivered`).
open_points.question: What test must show that no path is opened for the condition-1 cases omitted here, especially an absent parent or last segment and a segment whose metadata cannot be read?
options: Add each omitted condition-1 case and observe or instrument that no open occurs.
State that the listed cases are an exhaustive equivalence partition and identify which listed case covers each omitted condition.
Narrow INV-02 to only the cases named by this Required tests item.
open_points.default_guess: Add absent-component and metadata-read-failure cases with an open-call witness proving that the source path is never opened.

open_points.subject: INV-19 Required tests
open_points.text: INV-19: delivering content that has no placement under the name of a conflict copy fails with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure, adds no file except the project lock and changes no existing file (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`).
open_points.question: What must the test observe to prove the invariant that a new placement never reads a conflict copy, rather than merely proving that the eventual answer and durable state are correct?
options: Instrument opening or reading and assert that the conflict-copy path is never opened.
Make the conflict copy fail or signal if opened and assert that the signal is absent.
Change the invariant to assert only refusal and absence of durable writes.
open_points.default_guess: Instrument filesystem access and assert that the conflict-copy path is rejected from its name before any open or read.
